errors.evidence: The x-axis has major tick marks labeled every 10 years (20, 30, 40, etc.). While data points may exist for each year, stating the intervals are 'one' is ambiguous and could be misinterpreted as the labeled tick marks being every one year.
For the black line, the value at age 68 is approximately 15%. Describing this as 'near 0%' is an over-generalization.

For the gray line, the value at age 68 is approximately 20%, not 0%.
